scope: NextComp native Codex capability, configuration and agent inspection candidate
implementation: Shared schemaVersion 1 capability descriptor, connected initialize response version; unknown versions unavailable for newly added native operations.
Passive last-observed native runtime permissions distinct from saved requested permissions and disk configuration. Reads never resume a session.
Model catalog service tiers validated and stored for newly started turns; inherit omits native override. Steering remains unchanged.
User-opened Android and web runtime/settings, installed skills, MCP connections/tools, installed apps/plugins, hooks and native descendant views; no periodic polling.
Explicit enablement of catalog-verified skills/apps/MCP; app and MCP writes use native expectedVersion CAS. No arbitrary keyPath or filePath forwarding.
Native parent/child identity and direct-input capability determine navigation; source-qualified remote query and returned thread identity.
Goal controls unavailable; no goal or continuation activation introduced.

limits: Android compile/lint and integrated visual QA are reserved for root release owner; not claimed by this receipt.
No production service restart, deployment, APK install or real account/configuration mutations performed.
Exact 0.167.0 protocol qualification is not entitlement, policy permission, or successful tool execution.
Runtime permission observation can become stale when another client changes the thread; timestamp and source are shown.
Plugin installed inventory is inspection-only. Official plugin installation APIs remain under development; native disabledPluginIds explicitly does not filter capabilities yet.
Hooks inspect only; protocol has no dedicated hook configuration write RPC. Commands/prompts are not returned.
App/MCP enablement writes affect subsequent configuration loads; existing connections/turns may retain prior state. No automatic reload or restart.
Catalog discovery failures stay unavailable/unsupported and are never treated as an empty successful catalog; no retries of uncertain writes.
